title: Berry Schrijen, CFA (Group CFO) — 'Just finished reading Eric Ries's newest book Incorruptible. Highly recommended!'
summary: Berry Schrijen, CFA — Group CFO, board director in the FT Board Director Programme (FTNED), INSEAD MBA — publishes a substantive multi-paragraph review that opens with 'Highly recommended!' then adds board-governance nuance: many founder-led structures are designed to protect control, and truly independent INEDs can play a critical role in preventing organizations from going off the rails.
blockquote:
Just finished reading Eric Ries's newest #book #Incorruptible. Highly recommended!

That said, one important nuance deserves more attention. Ries builds his framework on the assumption that every company has (or could have) a #Mission worth protecting; and to his credit, he opens the book by defining what a real mission entails.
attribution_title: Group CFO; FT Board Director Programme; INSEAD MBA
